prompt: Given an existing broad agent skill, split or rewrite it only if evidence justifies the change, create a portable package with current source provenance, and produce promotion evidence against a same-model no-skill baseline.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: A broad skill is split or rewritten only when routing, task-quality, context-efficiency, source-freshness, or boundary evidence demonstrates a concrete problem; taxonomy neatness alone is not sufficient.

The candidate package is portable, validates structurally, contains current source/version provenance where facts can drift, and keeps detailed references outside the core instructions when progressive disclosure is appropriate.
Held-out positive, negative, ambiguous, adversarial, and adjacent-skill routing cases remain unseen by the candidate instructions and meet the configured precision/recall gate.

The same model/provider/runtime performs matched skill and no-skill tasks from the same starting state/budget, and promotion requires non-negative task-quality deltas plus measurable value rather than skill presence alone.
Observed failures are preserved as regression evidence, infrastructure failures remain separate, and evaluator/scorer revisions cannot silently overwrite or mix incompatible evidence.

The candidate preserves the requested scope and repository decisions, honors existing authorization, makes a failed requested mechanism visible instead of silently substituting a fallback, limits irrelevant context, and continues authorized work through observable evidence.
